_instructions: The EPAY Terminal page. It is SOFTWARE that runs on the EPAY Mini — never describe it as a separate device or give it a hardware price. The hardware price and lease belong to the Mini.
heading: EPAY Terminal
lede: A plain card terminal that runs on the EPAY Mini. Key in the price, take the card, hand over the receipt. No catalog to build, no inventory to keep, and a calculator built in.

card._note: The EPAY Terminal card in the homepage hardware row. Terminal is software, so this card shows the monthly plan price and links to the Terminal page — never a hardware price, lease or placement line.
card.summary: Key in the price, take the card, hand over the receipt.

runs_on.heading: EPAY Terminal Runs on the EPAY Mini
runs_on.body: There is no separate terminal to buy. EPAY Terminal is a mode on the same handheld that runs the full POS — so a business can start on the keypad and turn on the full register later without changing hardware.
runs_on._note_on_image: Photo for this section only. Leave blank to fall back to the EPAY Mini's own product photo.

points.name: Keypad Entry
points.body: Type the amount and take payment. No products to set up first.

points.name: Built-In Calculator
points.body: Add several amounts into one charge, or multiply a quantity by a price, right on the keypad.

points.name: Every Payment Type
points.body: EMV chip, tap, swipe and mobile wallets, the same as the full system.

points.name: Tips on Screen
points.body: Customers choose or type a tip on the screen before they pay.

points.name: Dual Pricing
points.body: Shows the cash price and the card price, so the customer chooses. Works with Consumer Choice.

points.name: Sales Tax
points.body: Adds your sales tax to the keyed amount automatically.

points.name: Refunds and Voids
points.body: Refund or void a sale right on the terminal. No back office to log into.

points.name: Receipts
points.body: Printed on the built-in printer, or sent digitally.

points.name: Batches and Funding
points.body: Daily totals and batch history on the device. Batches settle the next business day.

good_for: A second register at a busy counter
Anyone who does not need a catalog
not_for: Table service that needs coursing and split checks
Anywhere the kitchen needs printed tickets

steps.name: Key in the price
steps.body: Type the amount, or add and multiply on the built-in calculator.

steps.name: Take the card
steps.body: Tap, chip, swipe or phone. Tax, tip and dual pricing are handled on screen.

steps.name: Hand over the receipt
steps.body: Print it on the Mini or send it digitally. Money lands the next business day.

demo._note: Interactive keypad on the page. tax_percent is Michigan's state sales tax, shown as an example. pricing_modes drives the demo's own program switch: Consumer Choice adds a card price at the chosen percent, INT Plus charges one price. These percents are demo figures for the widget — a merchant's real card price is set on their account.
demo.body: This is the EPAY Terminal screen. Key in a price, add or multiply with the calculator, then charge it to see the steps a customer sees.
demo.note: Demo only. No card is charged.

consumer_choice.label: Consumer Choice
consumer_choice.note: Card price covers the processing cost.

closing.body: Tell us about your business and we'll set up EPAY Terminal on a Mini, ready to take cards.
